PLAN "12-week General Strength (post L4-L5 herniation)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength with spine-safe loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Foundation (4 weeks)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper — Push/Horizontal":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower — Hip-dominant (spine-safe)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper — Pull/Vertical":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
